stemMd: Which operation on two rational numbers is not always defined as a rational number?
explanationMd: Division fails when the second rational number is zero. All the other listed operations are defined for any pair of rational numbers and remain rational.

distractorRationale.d: Adding and dividing by 2 preserves rationality.
distractorRationale.b: The sum of rational numbers is rational.
